title: rest: every GET /api/v1/data/OBJECT still runs a full zod safeParse of the object's definition (the API-exposure gate's by-name read is decorated with diagnostics) — 11.8% of a HotCRM read's CPU
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post #24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#3053 rounds 1–2 (dev reports `6266807911` and `6267763185`). ⛔ Not a claim: the lane dispatches it.

**Why it matters.** Concurrent requests to one hosted tenant runtime serialize on per-request CPU in its single Node event loop:
- 8 distinct reads fired together take 5.4–8.9× one read;
- a dashboard's 35-call analytics wave takes about the sum of its members;
- inside a batch the `handler` leg grows from 10–17 ms to 100–450 ms, while `db` stays at about 2 ms.

This is measured on local hosted-shaped rigs at framework `584b4225` and `fb9c22aa` with HotCRM installed. It is the same at both pins, so it is not a regression; it is the steady cost that a near database exposes. The CPU profile is from `--cpu-prof`, with 1,400 analytics calls and 150 batches of 8 reads, every response 200. This card is one named slice of that CPU.

## What was measured (framework `fb9c22aa`)

- **The call chain:** the API-exposure gate `enforceApiAccess` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:2561-2600`) reads the object through `p.getMetaItem` (`:2586`). `readMetaItem` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:11284`) decorates it through `decorateMetadataItem` (`:11537` / `:11760`), then `metadata-diagnostics.ts:154-156`, then `computeMetadataDiagnostics` (`:55`, zod `safeParse` at `:97`).
- **What the gate uses:** only `obj.enable`.
- **Cost:**
  - 1.84 ms of 15.60 ms CPU per HotCRM `top=1` read (11.8%);
  - 3.2% on a bare fixture;
  - 0.35 ms per analytics call.

  It scales with the object's size, so real apps pay more.
- **Precedent:** #24031 removed the list-wide form of this cost; the by-name form remains.

## Target

The gate reads an undecorated item (no `_diagnostics`), or diagnostics are memoised per (type, name, version token). Redaction and diagnostics on SERVED metadata reads stay as they are.

## Acceptance

- A test counts `computeMetadataDiagnostics` calls per `GET /data/OBJECT` and asserts 0. Ablation: it goes red when the gate reads the decorated item again.
- `GET /meta/object/NAME` still serves its diagnostics.
